signals.label: Hidden caps
signals.finding: The deal says "unlimited", but the vendor's own pages meter usage.

evidence.quote: Rank in AI search and traditional SEO with unlimited, structured content by automating GEO + SEO content creation at scale in Google Sheets
Yes, truly unlimited. No user limits. No content limits. No website limits. No limits to creating sheets.

signals.label: Tier trap
signals.finding: The $59 tier lacks 3 of 4 features in the $189 tier.

signals.label: Vendor age & track record
signals.finding: Domain is about 3.4 years old. Sold on AppSumo 2 times before.

signals.label: Discount size
signals.finding: $59 vs a stated $189 regular price (69% off).

signals.label: One-sided change clauses
signals.finding: The terms let the vendor change features or pricing at any time.

trials.claim: Provides unlimited structured content for AI search and SEO at scale in Google Sheets
trials.claimQuote: Rank in AI search and traditional SEO with unlimited, structured content by automating GEO + SEO content creation at scale in Google Sheets
trials.reasoning: The vendor states it is truly unlimited with no content, user, website, or sheet limits, and a buyer confirms structured SEO-aware content in Google Sheets; paying AI usage costs does not impose a vendor content cap.

exhibits.quote: Create 30 Articles in 45 Min for Only $2!
exhibits.argument: Content costs extra money per article, so unlimited does not mean free or included.

exhibits.quote: At this time OpenAI, Claude, Google, Grok (& OpenRouter on Pro version).
exhibits.argument: Users must supply their own paid AI keys, which limits the unlimited content claim.

exhibits.quote: Yes, truly unlimited. No user limits. No content limits. No website limits. No limits to creating sheets.
exhibits.argument: Vendor states there are no content or sheet limits, supporting unlimited content at scale.

exhibits.quote: Structured, SEO-aware content, right in Google Sheets, pushed out cleanly wherever you need it to go.
exhibits.argument: Buyer confirms structured SEO-aware content is created directly in Google Sheets.

trials.claim: Includes all future Lite Tier 1 or Pro Tier 2 Plan updates
trials.claimQuote: All future Lite (Tier 1) or Pro (Tier 2) Plan updates
trials.reasoning: Reviews only show past updates, while the binding terms allow the vendor to revise terms and terminate access, so inclusion of all future updates cannot be verified from these exhibits.

exhibits.quote: We reserve the right to suspend or terminate your access to aahsheet.com at our discretion, without prior notice, for any violation of these Terms or for any other justifiable reason.
exhibits.argument: Vendor can take back access at discretion without notice, undermining guaranteed future updates.

exhibits.quote: We retain the right to revise these Terms periodically, with updated versions posted on aahsheet.com.
exhibits.argument: Vendor can unilaterally change terms, allowing limits on promised future updates.

exhibits.quote: it keeps on getting updates again and again – making it even better every time.
exhibits.argument: Buyer confirms the product keeps receiving repeated updates that improve it.

exhibits.quote: Shawn is consistently adding new features that was not the part of the deal earlier.
exhibits.argument: Buyer confirms new features are added beyond the original deal, supporting future updates.

trials.claim: Includes 16+ Google Sheet tools to scale content creation and drive traffic
trials.claimQuote: Access 16+ Google Sheet tools to scale content creation and drive more traffic to your site
trials.reasoning: No exhibit lists or counts 16+ tools; the exhibits only show Lite and Pro differ in AI connections, which neither proves nor disproves the tool count.

exhibits.quote: The reason OpenRouter is only available in Pro version is that it takes more to maintain the code and prompts required to run the flows.
exhibits.argument: Lite tier excludes major AI connections and flows, so not all buyers get 16+ tools.

exhibits.quote: Our lite version is still robust when connected to OpenAI.
exhibits.argument: Lite is limited to OpenAI only, contradicting access to the full tool suite.

trials.claim: Can generate SEO content in bulk and refresh daily with Autopilot Mode even when away
trials.claimQuote: Generate SEO content in bulk and refresh daily with Autopilot Mode, even when you’re out of the office
trials.reasoning: The vendor advertises creating 30 articles in 45 minutes and a buyer calls the autopilot mode for SEO content amazing; complaints about spreadsheet setup and interface do not contradict bulk autopilot generation.

exhibits.quote: if you screw up the content of a cell, or miss certain values, it can be a pain working out what's wrong
exhibits.argument: Autopilot requires precise manual setup and troubleshooting, not hands-off operation while away.

exhibits.quote: NOTE - It's a spreadsheet, so don't expect a lovely User Interface.
exhibits.argument: Manual spreadsheet operation and errors undermine reliable daily autopilot generation.

exhibits.quote: Create 30 Articles in 45 Min for Only $2!
exhibits.argument: Vendor advertises bulk SEO content generation of 30 articles in 45 minutes.

exhibits.quote: The autopilot mode for SEO content is amazing, and Shawn Altman (definitely an AI - no human answers queries that fast! 😄) keeps adding features
exhibits.argument: Buyer confirms the autopilot mode for SEO content works and is amazing.

trials.claim: Suite of AI Google Sheets, SEO flows and quick functions to create content at scale
trials.claimQuote: AahSheet is a suite of AI Google Sheets, SEO flows, and quick functions that help you create content at scale.
trials.reasoning: Two buyers confirm a suite of templates and workflows that turns Google Sheets into an AI content engine for SEO articles and more; one learning-curve complaint and a Pro-only connection do not negate that suite.

exhibits.quote: The reason OpenRouter is only available in Pro version is that it takes more to maintain the code and prompts required to run the flows.
exhibits.argument: Full suite of sheets, flows and functions is Pro-only, not included for all buyers.

exhibits.quote: AAHSHEET might be powerful, but the steep learning curve makes it frustrating to use.
exhibits.argument: Steep learning curve contradicts easy suite that helps create content at scale.

exhibits.quote: It offers a suite of pre-built templates and workflows designed to automate various aspects of content creation, from SEO optimised articles to Shopify product descriptions.
exhibits.argument: Buyer confirms it is a suite of templates and workflows for automating content creation including SEO articles.

exhibits.quote: It turns Google Sheets into a fully AI-driven content engine, making it effortless to produce high-quality, SEO-optimized articles, product descriptions, and so much more.
exhibits.argument: Buyer confirms AI-driven Google Sheets create SEO content at scale.
